section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations and strengths of a single study examining body appreciation and related constructs. The study involved 261 psychology students from a non-residential college in the northeastern U.S., with data collected using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). Key limitations include the correlational design, limited generalizability due to the select sample, and the measure of cosmetic enhancements being limited in scope. A strength is the focus on novel correlates of body appreciation related to self-enhancement and expression.

section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations and strengths of a single study examining the relationship between body appreciation and need for uniqueness among psychology students. The study was correlational in nature, conducted at a non-residential college in the northeastern U.S. with 261 participants. Key limitations include the correlational design, limited scope of cosmetic enhancement measures, and lack of generalizability due to the select sample of psychology students who may have been self-selected based on interest in body modification.
